title: Dahlia — Date ideas for the night you have
description: Find a date idea by mood, budget, and time. Build a plan, keep a date journal, and remember the little things with Dahlia for iPhone.
headline:
Less deciding.
More time together.
intro: An hour at home or a whole evening out: Dahlia gives you a specific idea for the time and budget you actually have. Pick a suggestion, make it yours, and keep a small record of the nights you share.
tagline: A plan for tonight, not another feed to scroll.
cardHeadline: Date ideas for the time and budget you have. Pick one, make a plan, go together.
purchaseNote: Dahlia Premium is an optional auto-renewing subscription. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings at least 24 hours before renewal.

steps.title: Choose what fits tonight
steps.text: Filter by mood, budget, time, and staying in or heading out. Optional relationship and lifestyle filters carry through to the ideas you see.

steps.title: Make a night of it
steps.text: Take a complete suggestion or use the Date Builder to combine an activity, food, and a twist. Save a plan and share an invite as text or a calendar file.

steps.title: Remember the good parts
steps.text: Mark a date as done, add how it went and a line to your journal, and watch your garden grow. Forget-me-nots keep useful details and important days close.

features.title: Specific ideas, not endless scrolling
features.text: The generator remembers what you have seen. Four full decks are free, with more than 400 ideas across the complete 14-deck collection.

features.title: Plans you can share
features.text: Send a calendar invite that opens on another phone, add a plan to your own calendar, or share a small plan file with another Dahlia user. Dahlia does not read your calendar.

features.title: A record worth keeping
features.text: The date journal is free. Back up favorites, history, plans, forget-me-nots, preferences, and streaks to a file, with an optional passphrase and a preview before restoring.

included: Four full decks, the generator, Date Builder, and filters
15 saved ideas, 3 saved Date Builder plans, and 10 forget-me-nots
Date journal, streaks, garden, and reminders
File backup and restore, plan invites, and Anniversary Mode
premium: Unlimited saved ideas, saved plans, and forget-me-nots
The full set of conversation prompts
Search, mood filtering, and export for your date journal
privacy: Date records and preferences live on your phone; no account is required to use the app.
Purchases and entitlement checks use Apple and RevenueCat. App updates use Expo; local activity storage does not mean the app never connects to the internet.
Sending an invite or saving a backup shares only when you choose. A passphrase for a backup is optional; keep the file and any passphrase safe.
limitations: Suggestions are entertainment, not relationship therapy or professional advice. Choose activities that suit your circumstances, boundaries, and accessibility needs.
The app supplies ideas and planning tools; it does not book venues, verify availability, or guarantee the outcome of a date.
Extra App Store listing languages do not imply translated app interfaces.
